To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the AlGaN-recession-free, ultrathins-barrier (UTS) AlGaN/Gan (mis)HFETs have been demonstrated on a GaN-on-SI platform, with the LPCVD-Sin3 passivation layer playing a critical role in the device fabrication and performance.
an ultrathin-barriers AlGaN/Gan heterostructure is proposed to fabricate and integrate GaN-based power-driven devices and circuits.
a recess-free technology is developed to integrate GaN-based power and RF devices and circuits on the same chip.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel approach for the fabrication of AlGaN-recession-free GaN-based HFETs and MIS-HFET-based power-driven circuits.
a recess-free technology, which is a promising approach to the fabrication and integration on GaN-based power and power-driven circuits for smart power integrated circuits.
the design and fabrication of a recess-free AlGaN/Ga N heterostructure for power and RF applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a new technology platform, which combines the benefits of both recess and non-recess technologies, is demonstrated for the fabrication of high-performance AlGaN/GaN power devices, power-driven circuits, and smart power integrated circuits.
the UTB-AlGaNGaN heterostructure has been proven to be an attractive technology platform to fabricate GaN power devices and power driven circuits.

the proposed UTB-AlGAN/GaN heterostructures and the related fabrication processes are promising technologies for the on-chips integration of GaN power and RF devices and power-driven digital circuits.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the recess-free, UTB-AlGn/GaN heterostructures are promising candidates for the fabrication of GaN power-driven devices and circuits.
the UTB-Al(Al)GaN/GaN technology is a promising technology for the fabrication of high-performance GaN-based power and RF devices as well as power-driven circuits.
the UTB-Al(0.3)GaN/GaN structure is an excellent platform for the integration of GaN devices and circuits.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the UTB-Al(0.2)GaN/GaN structure can effectively suppress the AlGaN recess and recover the 2D electron-gas in the access region, which is critical for the on-chap integration of power devices and power driven circuits.
the AlGaN/GaNSiNx structure can be a very good candidate for the fabrication of GaN-based smart integrated circuits.
the UTB-AlGaNGaN heterostructure can serve as a platform for the integration of power and radio-frequency (RF) devices with power-driven RF circuits on a single chip.
